title: The Handling Step Added to a Funding Lot at a Busy Micro Market
content:
A year of heavy drawing at the kiosk of an Unattended Micro Market Program market adds a handling step to the next funding lot, and the breadth of the range the market format carries settles how much.

## Conditions

**The call-out charge printed against the market format** is added as the handling step where at or above 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, and the market format carries at or above 250 distinct products.

**Half the call-out charge printed against the market format** is added where at or above 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over those twelve months, and the market format carries below 250 distinct products.

**Where less than 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over those twelve months**, no handling step is added.

## The boundaries

The active-kiosk year amount is 3000 USD drawn at the kiosk over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out: exactly 3000.00 USD is at or above it, and 2999.99 USD is below it. The wide-range product count is 250 distinct products carried in the format's planogram: a format carrying exactly 250 is at or above it, and a format carrying 249 is below it.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on which 5200.00 USD was drawn at the kiosk over the trailing year, on a format carrying 380 distinct products with a printed call-out charge of 165.00 USD, carries a handling step of 165.00 USD. On a format carrying 140 distinct products with a printed call-out charge of 110.00 USD, the step would be 55.00 USD. Where 900.00 USD was drawn over the year, no handling step is added at all.
